mapper.select: SELECT FROM execution_device WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO execution_device ( device_id, owner_id, hostname, platform, executor, agent_instance_id, codex_available, codex_executable_path, codex_version, codex_message, codex_checked_at, client_release, shell_release, last_seen_at, last_claimed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{deviceId}, #{ownerId}, #{hostname}, #{platform}, #{executor}, #{agentInstanceId}, #{codexAvailable}, #{codexExecutablePath}, #{codexVersion}, #{codexMessage}, #{codexCheckedAt}, #{clientRelease}, #{shellRelease}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{lastClaimedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_id = VALUES(owner_id), hostname = VALUES(hostname), platform = VALUES(platform), executor = VALUES(executor), agent_instance_id = VALUES(agent_instance_id), codex_available = VALUES(codex_available), codex_executable_path = VALUES(codex_executable_path), codex_version = VALUES(codex_version), codex_message = VALUES(codex_message), codex_checked_at = VALUES(codex_checked_at), client_release = VALUES(client_release), shell_release = VALUES(shell_release), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at), last_claimed_at = COALESCE(VALUES(last_claimed_at), last_claimed_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
